about.en: RIO is the native token of Realio Network, a layer-1 blockchain and platform for issuing, investing in and managing tokenised real-world assets and digital securities. Besides the native chain asset, RIO circulates as an ERC-20/BEP-20 at 0x94a8b4EE5CD64C79D0Ee816f467EA73009f51aA0 on Ethereum and BNB Chain, and on Solana and Base.
